auditCorrection: report-final.json had a pretty-vs-compact JSON string comparison bug in the supplemental RingLab separate-design check. This reviewed report compares parsed serialized objects; original static checks were53/53 all along. No source files modified.

visualReview.scope: Sample only:16 LevelGen proposals and12 RingLab shortlisted proposals, rendered independently with current core. No complete203-level art/gameplay review.
observations: LevelGen later sampled levels repeatedly add tall frames/long pin links and serial W1/W2 doors; no identical body layouts found by limited mirror/90-degree fingerprint, but this does not establish meaningful design diversity or difficulty.

RingLab owl V2_10042 and snowman V1_092 read more clearly than several other named figures at thumbnail scale. Elephant/dinosaur/bird figures require GD silhouette review; titles do not prove recognition.
41/53 ready RingLab proposals use3 or fewer body colour names; human contrast/variety review still needed.
Four ready RingLab proposals have no rings/pins:V1_008=25sticks,V1_024=17,V2_10111=23,V2_10122=25. Guide engagement is valid but does not establish intended cross-dependencies or meaningful roles.
